model.description: GPT-2-derived fixed optimizer benchmark, not original GPT-2

training.gradient_reduction: sum, as in upstream; any internal mean conversion must be explicit

data.revision_policy: reuse the verified pinned reference data manifest and shard hashes
data.validation_policy: development slice only until candidate and comparator are locked

evaluation.quality_comparison: fixed training tokens; end-to-end GPU-hours and memory are secondary diagnostics
evaluation.offset_convention: zero-based offset into shifted next-token target stream: inputs shard[offset:offset+count], targets shard[offset+1:offset+count+1]

confirmation.interval: two-sided 95% paired Student t interval over five training seeds
confirmation.pass: mean gain >=0.5 and lower confidence bound >0, with all five pairs complete
confirmation.usage: final checkpoint evaluation only after a frozen comparison manifest; never select candidates on this slice

claim_limits: five-seed t interval has distributional assumptions and limited power
same-corpus reserved slice is not an independent corpus
a known method or reimplementation is not a new mathematical invention

budget.reservation: reserve requested GPU count times Slurm wall limit before submission; reconcile terminal Slurm allocation seconds including failed jobs
budget.confirmation_policy: protect confirmation budget; measured five-pair costs must fit confirmation plus unused recovery before promotion
budget.prior_runs: historical runs are separately disclosed and not charged again to this new 64-hour authorization
budget.llama_transfer: deferred; produce a costed protocol after GPT-2 confirmation, without launching Llama jobs

development.comparison_controls: fixed auxiliary AdamW, architecture, global batch, tokenization, data order, precision, and 70% cooldown
development.search_policy: declare configs and balanced method-family caps before new results; expand boundary LR optima before claims; short schedules are screening only
development.tcd_policy: retain prior failures and controls; do not repeat completed screen or restart retired 150M campaigns
